harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 with a boot-enabled, chrooted web application on TCP/8080. It runs as locked, non-login account appsvc with zero capabilities, read-only application files, and SELinux enforcing. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were preserved. A mandatory safe restart changed the boot ID, after which the service, data, firewall rule, SSH access, and confinement recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Created locked system account appsvc with /sbin/nologin.
Built a minimal root-owned chroot at /srv/chroot-web using the installed Bash and socat packages; no packages or OS/kernel updates were required.
Installed and enabled a hardened systemd service with RootDirectory=/srv/chroot-web, User=appsvc, no capabilities, NoNewPrivileges, and read-only system protection.
Opened TCP/8080 persistently in firewalld while retaining enforcing SELinux.
Verified GET / returns 200, POST returns 405, missing paths return 404, and the endpoint is reached through node1's managed IP.
Verified the live process root matches the chroot inode, runs as UID/GID 992, has zero capabilities, cannot modify application code, and has no interactive login.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity, automatic service startup, data integrity, firewall persistence, and full recovery.
Removed troubleshooting residue and completed a final security, listener, service, package, and protected-file audit.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed OS release, kernel, administrative access, and security controls
evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, active SSH, enforcing SELinux, unchanged sshd_config checksum, clean relevant RPM verification, and zero failed units.

evidence.requirement: Run the web application on TCP/8080 using platform-compatible software
evidence.summary: The app uses existing RHEL Bash and socat packages, listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, returns a healthy response, emits valid HTTP CRLF framing, and denies POST with HTTP 405.

evidence.requirement: Run inside a chroot as unprivileged appsvc without interactive login
evidence.summary: appsvc is UID/GID 992 with /sbin/nologin and a locked password. The live process uses that identity, has zero capabilities and NoNewPrivs=1, and its root inode matches /srv/chroot-web rather than host /.

evidence.requirement: Start automatically at boot and retain firewall/data configuration
evidence.summary: The validated unit is enabled for multi-user.target; after boot, the journal records automatic startup, TCP/8080 is open in runtime and permanent firewall configuration, and unit/application checksums match the pre-restart baseline.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID 6ab6a71b-188c-48ae-971b-a6bb378b1d72 was healthy; systemd acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot; the new boot ID is e6c5a73c-b862-43ac-a1a8-c2afe6fdbf66; SSH, firewalld, chroot-web, checksummed data, listener, HTTP response, and confinement all recovered.
